name: Can I operate my business during retail tenant improvements?

mainEntity.name: Can I operate my business during retail tenant improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Operating your business during retail tenant improvements is generally challenging and often not recommended, especially for extensive projects. Construction noise, dust, and limited access can significantly disrupt customer experience and staff productivity. If a phased approach is feasible for very minor works, careful planning is essential to ensure safety and compliance. For most retail TIs, especially those impacting critical operational areas, it's more practical to plan for a temporary closure or relocation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Operating a business during extensive retail tenant improvements is difficult due to disruption and safety concerns; temporary closure or relocation is often more practical.
